confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate without live listing checks. Food, coffee and beer are scaled modestly below the Jakarta reference. Lodging reflects backpacker-district rates with a July peak-season allowance, and the 3-star anchor is the least certain. Cocktail and wine are set from the beer anchor (about double and about 2.8 times) because direct bar-price knowledge is weak. The FX value comes from search-result summaries citing the RBA 4pm 15 Oct 2026 figure, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Primarily Jakarta, Indonesia as the nearest comparable, adjusted down for Yogyakarta's generally lower food, drink and budget-lodging prices. Phnom Penh and Koh Samui are used only as broader Southeast Asian context.
